item.title: Denzel Boston: Not in line to practice Wednesday
item.description:
Boston isn't expected to practice Wednesday due to a toe injury, Daniel Oyefusi reports.

item.title: Deshaun Watson: Officially named Week 10 starter
item.description:
The Browns announced Wednesday that Watson (concussion) will start Sunday's game against the Texans, Kelsey Russo of the team's official site reports.

item.title: Deshaun Watson: Remains in line to start Sunday
item.description:
Watson (concussion) will serve as the Browns' starting quarterback in Sunday's game against the Texans, a source tells Mary Kay Cabot of The Cleveland Plain Dealer reports.

item.title: Puka Nacua: May be tracking for Week 14 or 15 return
item.description:
The Rams remain optimistic that Nacua (knee/toe) will be able to return to action Week 14 versus the 49ers or Week 15 versus the Cowboys, Dan Graziano of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Travis Etienne: Coach non-committal on Week 10 return
item.description:
Head coach Kellen Moore said Monday that the Saints haven't yet determined whether Etienne (hamstring) will return from injured reserve ahead of Sunday's game against the Panthers, Luke Johnson of The New Orleans Times-Picayune reports. "We'll see," Moore said. "He's progressing well. We'll gather some more information and make a decision."
